No INSERTED markers were computed for this fixture, so produced/stitched spots (preroll, the Hyundai+QVC mid-show pair, and the postroll) are labelled ADVERTISEMENT with delivery 'produced'; host-read ads (Sheath, GLD, PrizePicks, Take Ultra, Body Brain) are delivery 'host'.

Sheath + GLD + PrizePicks + Hyundai + QVC run back to back with no real show content between them, so they share group break-1 even though the first three are host reads and the last two are produced inserts.
The best-tits contest game itself (~0:15-0:29) and the ~42-minute audiobook-forward-reading bit (~1:17-1:59) are long stretches of ordinary show content next to no ad and are left unlabelled.

The golden-ticket/Skankfest mentions and the Jim Florentine / Bobby Kelly / Steve Rannazzisi / Story Wars / Gas Digital-subscribe block are all SELF_PROMOTION (alt NETWORK_PROMOTION for the Gas Digital/Story Wars parts); the 'It's me, I'm Better Help' bit right before the plugs block is a joke, not a real ad, so it's EITHER.
